_: DESIGNED, not recovered: who stands in the empty (type 0) spawn slots of Вади-Хальфа's camps and quest places, one type per slot in the file's order. Applied by server/rooms.py in war=1 locations, to these files only; every other file's empty slot stays empty. Built by data/build_spawn_substitutes.py (CAMP_FILL), which says why for each.

122.why: «Механик ДСР» (Q_VH_Mechanic, tooltip 5988,1714): the mechanic 717 and the ДСР of levels 7-8 texts.xml names for this line -- [7] Ополченец, [8] Диверсант, [7] Боевик, [8] Старший офицер, [7] Новобранец (10611-10615) -- whose creatures are not in mobs.xml (the ДСР jm_ it has are levels 12-14). Stand-ins of the level and a soldier's art that no location puts down: Ополченец m05_BanditShooter_lvl7 (62), Боевик m510_BanditAssaultRifle_lvl7 (90), Новобранец m510_Courier_lvl7 (51) -- all three in the mechanic's own art, mob-m2 -- Диверсант m510_BanditShotgunner_lvl8 (87), Старший офицер inv_8_cap (1040), two officers for «Операция "Возмездие"» (texts.xml 62728: «уничтожить 5 старших офицеров ДСР»). The rule that the officers come running at the shooting is not built: they stand from the start.
